# My Hudson Valley

> Local news and community information for Hudson Valley towns and villages covering government, schools, events, and municipal updates.

My Hudson Valley is a hyperlocal news platform serving the Hudson Valley region with town-specific pages, community updates, and the Wallkill Valley Times publication. The site aggregates local government news, school district information, community events, and municipal administration for residents across Orange County and surrounding areas.

## Key Topics

- Hudson Valley
- Local Government
- Community Events
- Town Updates
- School Districts
- Municipal Administration
- Local Elections
- Fire Department
- Fundraisers
- Housing Policy
- Wallkill Valley Times
- Cornwall Central School District
- Most Precious Blood School
- Community News
- Regional Events

## Publications & Regional Coverage

- [Wallkill Valley Times](https://timeshudsonvalley.com/wallkill-valley-times): Wallkill Valley Times publication covering regional news and events
- [Home | My Hudson Valley](https://timeshudsonvalley.com): Homepage for My Hudson Valley local news covering Hudson Valley communities
